newsitem.title: USA: Uruguay to seek one mln bbls of crude for end-July.
newsitem.headline: Uruguay to seek one mln bbls of crude for end-July.

text.p: Uruguay's state oil refiner ANCAP will seek to buy one million barrels of crude oil for delivery at the end of July in a formal tender to be announced probably next week, trade sources said on Friday.
The company is seeking to purchase crude with an API gravity of 26-45 degrees and a sulfur content of 0.5 percent to 1.8 percent.
The crude is to be delivered to Uruguay's Jose Ignacio terminal.
Separately, Colombia's state oil company Ecopetrol today plans to award a tender for Vasconia crude loading around June 23-30.
